verdict.rationale: Snowflake's own docs include a 'Regulatory compliance' section with per-certification pages for SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS, SOC 1 Type II, ISO-27001/27017/27018, FedRAMP Moderate/High and CSA STAR. That gives a security reviewer documented attestations to work from, covering the core of the story. Missing for 10: HIPAA is not listed in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that the attestations speed up security review.
